body: Extended the two decorative ArenaNode markers into a real capture contest (arena_tick_nodes: weighted team presence -> signed pressure -> threshold-derived owner). Merged the former Druid into Flamel per founder direction (TYLER lore confirmed Druid had no named-character backing). Added Morrigan (meta jungler, contested-ground affinity) and Dagda (two-natured club Q: kills a hittable enemy in range, else heals a hurt ally) per founder direction, both real TYLER entries (#68/#69). Centralized apply_damage() across every damage site so Pizza's real HP-floor R works consistently. Roster 5 -> 10, pick-validation/draft-modulo widened. 62 new headless tests (216 total). Verified live: full 10-hero roster drafted correctly across a real 20-bot match, persistent pool relaunched on freshest build and left running. REDGARDEN acdd8ce.
title: Territory system + Tree, Pizza, Flamel, Morrigan, Dagda
